name: reversi
description: A React + Node.js reversi/othello game with a GraphQL API

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=src/server & npm run dev --workspace=src/client & npm run dev --workspace=src/shared
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=src/server && npm run build --workspace=src/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=src/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=src/client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=src/shared && npm run test --workspace=src/server
